Name: Nathan
Summary: Nathan was David's court prophet who announced God's everlasting covenant and later confronted David over his sin with Bathsheba. He remained loyal to God's purposes into Solomon's reign.
KeyStory: Nathan told David the parable of the poor man's lamb, then declared, You are the man, leading David to repentance.
LifeLesson: Nathan loved David enough to tell him the hard truth. Real hope sometimes begins with honest conviction — and God meets the repentant with mercy, not rejection.
